endpoint.selection: Published global endpoint or exact scoped override; no inferred region/pool
endpoint.ref_validation: Caller ResourceRef scope/service/generation/kind/endpointID/URL and root shape checked before credential/resource I/O

response.mapping: GetTicketResponse required success boolean/description/ticket strings; preserves false distinctly from missing. Ticket and description protected; ticket is never a resource identifier or receipt ref. HTTP acceptance is not a device/control connection.

errors.mapping: Documented default ApiError mapped through shared safe status taxonomy, raw messages omitted; receipt retained on all errors, including missing project pre-I/O.

retry: No replay; one resource attempt on unknown outcome. Documented 4xx rejection statuses retain rejected receipt;500/transport/decode failures preserve uncertainty/acceptance as applicable.

recovery.reason: Single-delivery ticket has no observation or replay proof; unknown returns receipt without fabricated refs.
